request: 策略 模型 推理强度，不同回话之间是可以不同的
acceptance: Persist strategy/profile/model/reasoning choices per ordinary session; switching sessions must restore choices without changing global defaults.
Provider URL, vault key, model capabilities and context preview follow selected session model; running tasks use immutable selection snapshots.
Retry/resume retain original task choices; parallel analysis and subagents inherit the proper task model/reasoning.
Draft choice survives new-session submission; stale save/preview responses cannot repaint a different session.
Race/API routing tests, UI component checks, docs and incremental push; scoped local8097 update with backup and smoke tests.

requirements.summary: Per-session selection of strategy/model/reasoning, per user; model/provider catalogs stay shared.

design.summary: Persist non-secret selection on Session and snapshot on Task; resolve per-model provider/key without mutating global settings, wire previews and retry/resume. Draft UI state is separate from existing session state.

implementation.summary: Backend session/task selection and per-model routing implemented; frontend complete and component observed. Final checks/build pending.

verification.summary: Both focused Go race profiles passed and both quick profiles passed. Native Safari actual menu/module synthetic saves: A/B choices differ and restore, reasoning low/high isolated, globals unchanged; dark/light observed. No real model calls.

documentation.summary: Bilingual ownership, API/CAS, task snapshots, routing/vision, legacy behavior and local single-provider compatibility recorded.

cleanup.summary: Preserved existing vendor deletions and unrelated local work. Fixture output ignored; no extra server or real model call.

release.summary: Incremental backend push prepared; frontend and local8097 candidate pending final receipt.

release_authorization: Prior user: incremental tests/push and documentation; update local8097 AIDE only, preserve other services/data. No release tag/main merge.
rollback: Revert scoped task commits and rebuild. Additive session fields do not require destructive migration; original data volume remains mounted. Backup before runtime replacement.
handoff: No real model calls. Native Safari actual8097 interaction remains behind manual certificate handling. Canonical and local checkout have different provider architectures and are verified separately.
local_compatibility: Local8097 checkout lacks canonical ModelProviders/ProviderID/vault routing. Its helper preserves shared legacy endpoint/key; tests validate both model IDs and effort on the shared mock endpoint. Canonical tests additionally validate distinct provider endpoints/keys. Existing local changes preserved.
